source.title: TNoodle 0.11.1
source.content:
TNoodle-WCA-0.11.1 is now available from [https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles)

The following change has been made since TNoodle 0.10.0:

- The colour scheme of Megaminx and Square-1 has been changed to the ones widely used today.
- The scramble generation process for Fewest Moves has been changed. Fewest Moves scrambles are now longer and the scramble sequence is no longer directly related to the puzzle state they produce. In particular, all scramble sequences for Fewest Moves are padded with the moves *"R' U' F"* at the beginning and the end.

Please remember that official competitions must use the current version of the official scramble program. This is always available from: [https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles)

translation.title: TNoodle 0.11.1 发布
translation.content:
TNoodle-WCA-0.11.1 现已发布，可在 [https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles) 获取。

相较于 TNoodle 0.10.0，本次改动如下：

- 五魔方和 Square-1 的配色改为目前广泛使用的配色。
- 修改最少步打乱的生成流程。最少步打乱现在更长，打乱序列不再与其生成的魔方状态直接相关。具体来说，所有最少步打乱序列的开头和结尾均补上 *R' U' F*。

请注意，正式比赛必须使用当前版本的官方打乱程序。最新版始终可在 [https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles) 获取。
